Succinctly, the genesis of the present proceedings is a complaint filed by Sh. Bishan Chandra, Sub. Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Paharganj, Delhi (hereinafter referred to as the 'complainant'), regarding the receipt of information of fake affidavit of one, Smt. Anita, W/o. Shri. Rajinder. Markedly, under his complaint the complainant inter alia proclaimed that an information was received from Smt. Anita, avowing that one Affidavit in her name had been obtained in a fraudulent manner, by forging her/Smt. Anita's signatures by her brother, Shri Raj Kumar Sharma. In particular, it was specifically asserted under the complaint that the said forgery was committed by Shri. Raj Kumar Sharma, with an intention to grab her/Smt. Anita's share in property as well as the money in her bank account. The complainant further declared under his complaint that the said Affidavit was attested by forging the stamp of the Office of SDM, Paharganj, besides the same was Rekha Sharma vs State (Nct Of Delhi) on 28 May, 2026 never attested by him/the complainant. Ergo, under said facts and circumstances, the complainant forwarded his complaint along with the complaint/information received from Smt. Anita to the concerned police official(s)/police station, which was eventually marked to the concerned police station/PS. Paharganj, whereupon the instant FIR came to be registered, and investigation ensued. Relevantly, during the course of ensuing investigation, statements of various ABHISHEK GOYAL GOYAL 2026.05.29 16:47:26 +0530 witnesses were recorded; documents and specimen/admitted signatures of the witnesses and alleged persons were obtained, and subsequently, further investigation of the present case was marked to the Anti-Forgery Section, EOW, Crime Branch. 2.1. Raj Kumar Sharma was obtained, wherein he specifically stated that he had not signed any Affidavit, and that the Affidavit submitted in bank was forged. 2005, Shri. Raj Kumar Sharma purchased two stamp paper of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten only) denomination, bearing SL Nos. 51231 and 51232. Consequently, by seeking recourse to the process of photography and preliminary examination by experts of FSL/forensic science laboratory/fingerprints bureau, the said documents were subjected to examination.
